inputs.prompt:
Use Picture 1 as the visual reference and repaint it with improved overall artistic quality. Retain its main subject, recognizable design, broad composition and artistic medium: keep illustration illustrated, cel art cel shaded and pixel art pixel art. Improve the image as a whole, including form, materials, lighting and background. Keep the existing subject count, age appearance and clothing coverage. For an isolated cutout, keep its outer boundary and plain surrounding matte so it fits the original transparent silhouette; repaint within that boundary. For a complete scene, integrate the subjects and background with consistent lighting and color.

Substantially repaint the whole artwork as a polished finished illustration. Redraw weak facial features and anatomy, replace flat or muddy shading with clear volumes, coherent key light, reflected light and grounded shadows. Develop convincing materials and expressive fabric folds. Rework background shapes, depth, color relationships and focal contrast together. Allow substantial changes to local shapes, details and lighting. Keep the main subject recognizable and the overall scene readable. Favor deliberate shapes and an integrated finish over extra tiny texture, heavy outlines or sharpening halos.

low quality, worst quality, blurry, overexposed, oversaturated, artifacts, jpeg artifacts, distorted anatomy, deformed hands, extra fingers, missing fingers, poor face, bad eyes, disfigured, watermark, text, logo, cluttered background, minor, child, underage, loli, shota, childlike face, childlike body
